plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for ZTE OLT access device. It reports uptime, board CPU utilization, board memory utilization, board temperature, fan and power supply status, and interface traffic, for ZTE ZXA10 OLT / AN chassis (enterprise PEN 3902).
name: Access

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Board CPU load of the ZTE ZXA10 from ZTE-AN-CHASSIS-MIB zxAnCardCpuLoad (per card, 0-100 %), shown as the busiest card. Cards that report 0 (attribute not supported) are skipped.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the ZTE ZXA10 cards in bytes, from zxAnCardMemSize (reported in MB per card), summed across cards.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Board memory utilization of the ZTE ZXA10 from zxAnCardMemUsage (per card, 0-100 %), shown as the highest card. Cards that report 0 (attribute not supported) are skipped.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Highest card temperature of the ZTE ZXA10 from ZTE-AN-ENVMON-MIB zxAnCardTemp, in degrees Celsius. Zero (invalid) readings are skipped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Fan operational status from ZTE-AN-ENVMON-MIB: OnlineStatus offline keeps a row as 1 (normal, empty slot); OperStatus up=1, down=2 (abnormal); OnlineStatus or OperStatus unknown=3 (gray, no alert).

metrics.name: device_fan_rpm
metrics.description: Actual fan speed from ZTE-AN-ENVMON-MIB zxAnEnvFanActualSpeed, in revolutions per minute.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power supply input voltage status from ZTE-AN-ENVMON-MIB zxAnPowerSupplyInVoltageStatus: normal=1, over-voltage/under-voltage/off=2 (abnormal). Off supplies keep a row.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from IF-MIB inbound octet counters (prefer 64-bit ifHCInOctets).

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from IF-MIB outbound octet counters (prefer 64-bit ifHCOutOctets).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart, derived from IF-MIB sysUpTime.
